meta.name: acreadiness-generate-instructions
meta.description: Generate tailored AI agent instruction files via AgentRC instructions command. Produces .github/copilot-instructions.md (default, recommended for Copilot in VS Code) plus optional per-area .instructions.md files with applyTo globs for monorepos. Use after running /acreadiness-assess to close gaps in the AI Tooling pillar.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成 AI 助手指令文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中配置 AI 编码助手的指令文件。
copy.tagline_en: Generate AI agent instruction files for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure AI coding assistant instructions in your project.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的代码库自动生成 AI 编程助手的指令文件，例如 .github/copilot-instructions.md，支持单文件或按主题/区域拆分成多个 .instructions.md 文件，并自动设置文件作用范围。
howto.when: 当你要求“生成”或“刷新”AI 助手指令文件，或者在运行了 /acreadiness-assess 评估后需要改进 AI 工具支柱时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成 Copilot 指令文件，使用嵌套策略。
say.note: Claude 会创建主文件和多主题文件。

say.text: 为我的 monorepo 生成区域指令，区域包括 frontend 和 api。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate AI agent instruction files tailored to your codebase, such as .github/copilot-instructions.md, with support for single file or nested per-topic/per-area .instructions.md files, automatically setting file scopes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'generate' or 'refresh' AI agent instructions, or after running the /acreadiness-assess skill to improve the AI Tooling pillar.

say_en.text: Generate Copilot instructions with nested strategy.
say_en.note: Claude creates a hub file and topic files.

say_en.text: Generate area instructions for my monorepo, areas: frontend and api.
say_en.note: Claude reads agentrc.config.json and creates .instructions.md with applyTo.
